title: Add date-aware scheduled seed lines to the journal runbook
rubric: Ordinary seed lines and existing runbook output remain backward-compatible when no directive is present
The on-date directive includes only on the exact target runbook date and validates real calendar dates
The from/every-N-days directive handles before-start exclusion, divisibility, month/year rollover, and leap-year differences
The weekday directive handles comma lists, case-insensitivity, whitespace, and invalid weekday tokens
Invalid directives add the specified note format without aborting the build or creating a card
Scheduled seed card titles and What/How bodies strip the directive prefix and preserve seed ordering
Scheduled seeds deduplicate by stripped title so existing carried/enriched cards still win
The implementation stays offline/stdlib-only and does not add subprocess, scheduler, home-dir, or generated-file behaviour
